claims: The final space shuttle launch was mission STS-135.
Atlantis lifted off from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on July 8, 2011, at 11:29 a.m. EDT.
STS-135 was commanded by Chris Ferguson.
STS-135 marked the end of NASA's 30-year space shuttle program.
STS-135 delivered essential supplies to the International Space Station.
The launch site of STS-135 was Launch Pad 39A, Kennedy Space Center.
The crew of STS-135 was Commander Chris Ferguson, Pilot Doug Hurley, and Mission Specialists Sandra Magnus and Rex Walheim.
The objective of STS-135 was to deliver the Raffaello multi-purpose logistics module with over 8,000 pounds of supplies and spare parts to the International Space Station.
The Space Shuttle Program began with the first flight in April 1981.
Atlantis landed back at Kennedy Space Center on July 21, 2011.
